name: seed-of-hope-website
description: WordPress block theme, core plugin and tooling for the Seed of Hope / Semence d'Espoir website.
author: Samuel BITINGINGWA (FreeDev-Group)

scripts.setup: docker compose up -d --wait && docker compose run --rm cli sh /scripts/setup.sh
scripts.lint: npm run lint:contrast && npm run lint:php
scripts.lint:php: docker compose run --rm composer sh -c "composer install --no-interaction --no-progress --quiet && composer lint"
scripts.lint:php:fix: docker compose run --rm composer sh -c "composer install --no-interaction --no-progress --quiet && composer fix"
